# IndexNow.io

> Guides and a free Shopify app for getting stores indexed on Bing and the AI
> search surfaces built on Bing's index (ChatGPT search, Microsoft Copilot,
> DuckDuckGo, Yahoo). Independent site; the official IndexNow protocol spec
> lives at https://www.indexnow.org.

## App

- [Bing SEO: IndexNow for Bing](https://apps.shopify.com/bing-seo-indexnow-for-bing): Free Shopify app that auto-submits product, collection, page, and blog URLs to Bing and Yandex via the IndexNow protocol, with bulk submission and tracking.

- [Get Shopify Products into ChatGPT, Copilot & AI Search](https://indexnow.io/blog/get-shopify-products-into-chatgpt/)
- [Fix "Discovered but Not Crawled" in Bing Webmaster Tools](https://indexnow.io/blog/bing-discovered-but-not-crawled/)
